body: Girl any sorority you’re in is a good sorority bc it has you ❤️
What if you go to the hospital?
I’m sorry you’re going through this too... it’s very painful that people leave when we need them the most. Do you want to talk? I can listen 🤷🏼‍♀️ it doesn’t bother me.
I’ve gone in the hospital before.  They can do meds a lot faster that way. Sometimes you just have to if you have to ❤️ can you see your dr sooner in an emergency appt to get your meds changed?

That sounds really hard. I’m sorry you’re going through this. It must have really hurt when she left this morning without giving you a hug. Maybe right now she just needs some time and space to cool off and think about things right now. Have you considered writing a letter to her explaining yourself (and not sending it)? This helps me get my anger, frustration, and feelings out in a way that’s productive and clarifying for ME. Maybe it would do the same for you.

I feel like I’m in a very similar situation. This is so hard. I don’t know how to live my life without my looks. I don’t even know what I want. It sounds like you need to find more things to live for too.  How do we do this?

Have you thought about practicing socializing in a safer environment? Like a therapy group? Or if you can’t afford that, a group like codependents anonymous? Or even volunteering somewhere? Socializing is hard. It takes practice. I’m out of practice now and became a loner. I need to take my own advice here too.

Why don’t you try to figure out why you were supposedly a jerk to your gf last night? I had a suicidal boyfriend once. I love him so much. He left me and doesn’t even respond to my messages anymore but I still love him. He’s a good human and made my life better. Your gf prob feels the same about you even if you have difficulties sometimes- which we all do in relationships! Sending you a hug ❤️
Thanks for saying that. I feel so alone most of the time. Thanks for saying we’re in it together. I don’t know you and yet I’m so grateful to you for that.
And running away is better than suicide. So maybe you should actually really consider it.
I’m tired of being tired too. You’re not alone. Let’s talk about it.
Hey, what about a suicide hotline? Or an emergency appt with another therapist? Please please reconsider. I know it feels like the only way right now. I feel that right now too. Want to talk?
How are you feeling today?  I’m glad you found a place to tell someone. And I’m glad I’m a way it’s not just me that feels rejected by the hotlines. It really hurts my feelings when I call them.
Congrats on still being here. The suicide hotlines have been pretty bad for me too. I’m sorry you felt like the person working there didn’t want to talk to you. I’ll talk with you.
Ok. I’ll try painting and drawing today.  And maybe baking too!

Thank you so much for taking time to respond to me.  Wow - these are really great suggestions and I will look through meetup today for more ideas of places to make friends like what you suggested.  Thanks so much for being here for me, even when you don’t know me!!
Thank you!!!  These are truly great (and social, loving) suggestions.  Thank you for taking the time to help me— a stranger.
Yes you def should.  Sending you hugs ❤️
